data.cultural_impact: The name Rajratan carries a strong cultural significance in Hindu society. It symbolizes the power, prosperity, and wealth that comes with being a king or a leader. It is a name that is often given to babies born into royal families or to children who are destined for greatness in their future careers. The name is also associated with the Hindu god of wealth, Ganesha, who is often depicted as holding a large ratan (jewel) in his hand.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rajratan represents the inner jewel or treasure that lies within each one of us. It reminds us that our true value and worth come from within, and not from external wealth or power. The name also symbolizes the idea of being a "king" or ruler of our own lives, responsible for making wise and just decisions and leading ourselves towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
